values.meaning: delay before damage/knockup lands after arrival
values.binNote: wiki's 0.35s delay is not found in the sheet; no matching data value.

mechanics.claim: Rakan dashes to the target location, then after a delay deals damage and knocks up nearby enemies.
mechanics.quote: '''Rakan''' {{tip|dashes}} to the target location. After a {{fd|0.35}}-second delay upon arrival, he deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|airborne|knocks them up}} for 1 second.

mechanics.claim: Cooldown starts on cast, not on landing.
This ability has no minimum dash range.
mechanics.quote: ''Grand Entrance'' has no minimum dash range.
